newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index stagnates at 100.526 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index stagnates at 100.526 pts.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds stagnated in Thursday's trading at 100.526 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.549 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, remained unchanged at 96.729 points, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.325 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.124 points to 1,152.268.
